note: Pass 2 subtasks only — every Pass 2 subtask present in this set was extracted; this house is NOT fully extracted (skipped pages were skipped on purpose). Read from the drawings: school building สปช. 103/26, one storey with a raised floor (+0.90 classrooms, +0.80 corridor), 3 classrooms, grid 1-7 x A-B-C = 27.00 x (6.50 + 2.00 corridor), grid bubbles printed. Structural sheets S-01..S-11 (pages 17-27): S-01 footing plan (F1 x7 on row A, F2 x7 on row B, C1 x14) -> footing_plan; S-02 beam/slab/column plan -> beam_plan (B2 on A and the two joist lines A''/A''' at 6.50/3, B4 on B, B1 on the corridor edge C, B3 across every grid A-B split at the joist lines, B3' cantilevers B-C, steel corridor posts on C) + etc_plan (S2 x18 / S1 x6 slab panels); S-03 roof beams R1/R2 -> beam_plan; S-04 steel trusses TRUSS T1 on grids 1-7 + purlins -> roof_frame_plan; S-05 footings F1 (1.30x1.30, 9 piles) / F2 (1.30x1.80, 12 piles) + C1 by level; S-06 beams B1/B2/B4/R1/R2, slabs S1/S2, lintel/sill/tie-column/corbel details; S-07 B3/B3' + entrance stair; S-08 truss T1 (steel + timber alternative); S-09 truss connection details; S-10/S-11 roof-steel and roof-timber notes. Door/window detail sheets A-10 (D1) and A-11 (W1) recorded as schedule rows. Grid master swept pages 05, 07-10, 17-24, 26 (incl. every z level printed on elevations/sections). Skipped on purpose: pages 01-02 covers (title), 03 sheet index (index), 04 symbol legend + finish table (symbol), 05 floor plan and 06 roof plan (architectural; dimensions swept only), 07-10 elevations/sections (side_profile; swept only), 11 and 14-16 architectural details (stair/railing, blackboard walls, wall details), 28 electrical plan.
